target.title: Add CLI cards view
target.body:
## Summary
- Add `codexbar cards`, a one-shot terminal usage snapshot with a responsive provider card grid.
- Add `codexbar cards --brief`, a compact Provider / Usage / Reset table with source/plan detail and enhanced terminal colors.
- Reuse the existing `codexbar usage` fetch pipeline, summarize provider failures in a footer, and document the new command.

## Test plan
- `swift test --filter 'CLICards|CLITerminalCapabilities'` (19 tests)
- `swift build --product CodexBarCLI -c release`
- `git diff --check`
- `make check` reaches SwiftFormat cleanly, then fails on this Linux host when SwiftLint/SourceKit cannot load `libsourcekitdInProc.so`.

## Terminal proof (redacted)

## Notes
- Root screenshot artifacts and the release-owned changelog entry were removed from the branch after review feedback.
- `Package.swift` and `Package.resolved` are intentionally unchanged in the final PR surface.
- Enhanced rendering now defaults only on Kitty/Ghostty/WezTerm/truecolor-capable terminals, with `CODEXBAR_CARDS_ENHANCED=1` as an explicit override.
- `7566af4` fixes zero-usage/zero-remaining bar rendering in standard brief and card grid paths.
